[SWS_Fee_00081]
Upstream requirements: SRS_MemHwAb_14031
⌈If the current module status is MEMIF_BUSY (i.e. the request to cancel a pending job
is accepted by the function Fee_Cancel), the function Fee_Cancel shall reset the
FEE module’s internal variables to make the module ready for a new job request from
the upper layer, i.e. it shall set the module status to MEMIF_IDLE.⌋
